gamma.flip_reason: no zero crossing within 20% of the price
gamma.label: modelled, convention-signed (calls positive, puts negative), prior-close open interest: an assumption about dealer inventory, not an observation
gamma.method: SpotGamma's published convention; Alpaca greeks, else Black-Scholes on the contract's implied volatility; open interest from the prior close; the flip re-prices the contracts that carry an implied volatility

har.method: HAR-RV (Corsi 2009) next-day realized vol, annualized; the 68% one-day band is HAR x 0.88 / 15.87

insider.reason: No insider trades on record for this name.

move.method: IV30 / 15.87 for one day (x sqrt 5 for the week); the straddle is the front expiry's at-the-money call plus put at mid, the market's own priced move to that expiry

news.reason: No headline for this name this session.

options.iv_rank_reason: IV rank waits for 252 stored IV30 readings; 1 stored

pins.method: the strike of most open interest within 5% of the price per expiry; counts, not a forecast

short.reason: No short-interest reading is available yet.

walls.reason: No earlier dealer-gamma reading of this name to compare against yet.
